seoTitle: Org Chart Maker from a CSV of Names and Managers
metaDescription: Make a top-down organisation chart from rows of name, manager and title. Loops and unknown managers are reported. Free SVG, private.
intro: Reads people and their managers and draws the reporting tree with names and titles, with a table of levels.
why:
Most HR exports are already a list of people with a manager column. Paste it and get the chart without redrawing boxes.

Several people without a manager become several roots side by side. A manager who is not in the list, a duplicate name or a reporting loop produces a clear error naming the person, which also makes it a quick data check before you import the file elsewhere.
howTo: Paste rows: name, manager, title (header optional).
Leave the manager empty for the top person.
Fix any named error and run again.

faq.q: Can there be several top people?
faq.a: Yes, each starts its own tree.

faq.q: What if two people share a name?
faq.a: Make names unique, for example by adding an initial.

faq.q: Is the chart wide for big teams?
faq.a: Yes. Width grows with the number of people at the bottom level.
Yes, it never leaves the page.
